alt: A short film with no voice, with music. An entryway with a door on the right. A small ink-black block figure with white eyes walks up to the door, gives it a small shake, a speech bubble says locked and its eyes turn happy. It walks back, stops with wide eyes and a bubble says did I? and walks to the door again, shakes it, and this time the bubble says locked with a bigger happy pulse. It walks back to exactly where it started, so the film can repeat without a cut. The text stays: me checking the door again.
